headline: REC and PFC merger plan sets 88-for-100 share swap ratio

modes.bear: Merger integration risks and share dilution concerns may create near-term volatility for existing shareholders of both entities.
modes.bull: Consolidating two power sector giants creates a stronger, unified state-owned lending powerhouse with enhanced balance sheet strength.
modes.simple: REC and PFC are planning to merge, meaning shareholders will get 88 shares of the new combined company for every 100 shares they currently hold.

summary: REC and Power Finance Corporation (PFC) are moving forward with a merger plan featuring an 88-for-100 share swap ratio. This corporate restructuring consolidates two major state-owned power sector lenders. For Indian retail investors holding either stock, the swap ratio determines the exact conversion of their shareholdings under the merged entity.
why_it_matters: Your holding ratio shifts under the proposed merger terms.

headline: Suzlon, PB Fintech, PFC and Mazagon among 17 stocks facing potential short covering
hook: Seventeen F&O names flagged for reversal
summary: Bajaj Broking has identified 17 derivatives stocks that could experience short covering based on current market setups. Suzlon Energy, Policybazaar operator PB Fintech, Power Finance Corporation, and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders feature on this list. Short covering occurs when bearish traders buy back borrowed shares to exit losing positions, which can trigger sharp upward price movements. Indian retail derivatives traders track these setups to spot potential near-term price bounces in heavily shorted counters.

winners_losers: Short sellers hurt / stock buyers gain
